title: DeepSeek Unification Atoms Audit

canonical_node.axiom: The Unification Atom Set is a proposal draft that is not yet canon-aligned; it requires overclaim removal, vocabulary alignment, explicit kill edges, and a warranted grade mapping before it can function as the graph's unification layer.
definitions: Canonical C_W wrapper: a wrapper, not a boundary-condition wrapper; boundary condition is an open R ruling.
R_agency(t): the agency parameter distinct from the open R ruling.
External slot (): grace/external source; openness requirement.
Kill edge: a condition that, if met, invalidates the claim.
Canonical grade vocabulary: MAPPED, DERIVED, SPLIT, PARTIAL, OPEN, LOCKED, DEFINITIONAL.
Bridge-status categories: 12 categories; no silent truth propagation.
derivation: The audit compares the Unification Atom Set against the Aug 9 canonical Master Equation.
It identifies blocking issues: all 10 UC atoms lack explicit kill edges; 6 contain overclaims or non-canonical vocabulary; 4 are broadly supportable but need repairs.
It maps each UC atom to canonical relations, warrant labels, boundaries, and required kill edges.
It lists non-canonical vocabulary and retired-claim watch items.
It provides an upgrade list for canon alignment.
canonical_node.action: Treat the Unification Atom Set as a non-canonical proposal. Apply the upgrade list: add kill edges, rewrite overclaiming atoms, replace non-canonical vocabulary, map warrant taxonomy, and re-stamp for Aug 9 canon. Do not admit any UC atom into the canonical graph until these repairs are made.
boundary: Does not establish any UC atom as canon-compliant as written.
Does not provide the actual kill edges; only specifies required kill edges.
Does not resolve the open R ruling or C_W identity.
Does not claim any formal proof or verified artifact.
Does not endorse the D/C/E/P/H/T/A/O warrant taxonomy as canonical.
test: Check that each UC atom has an explicit kill edge listed.
Check that overclaiming atoms (UC-01, UC-03, UC-05, UC-07, UC-08, UC-09) are rewritten per the upgrade list.
Check that non-canonical vocabulary is replaced or marked domain-specific.
Check that the warrant taxonomy is mapped to canonical grades.
Check that the atom set is re-stamped for Aug 9 canon.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides an audit framework and upgrade list for aligning the Unification Atom Set with the Aug 9 canon, including required kill edges and vocabulary repairs.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the canonical Master Equation and its boundaries; does not alter any canonical claims.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If removed, the Unification Atom Set remains non-canonical and unaligned; the audit trail for its repair is lost.
dg5_translation_registers: Canonical grade vocabulary: MAPPED, DERIVED, SPLIT, PARTIAL, OPEN, LOCKED, DEFINITIONAL
Non-canonical terms: socket, trial-stack verdict, constraint-class, reduction-class, typeclass sense, normative pole, boundary-condition wrapper, McMillions-class anchors

overstatement_risks: Claiming the Unification Atom Set is canon-aligned when it is not.
Using non-canonical vocabulary as if canonical.
Treating the audit's required kill edges as actual kill edges.
Assuming the upgrade list has been implemented.
kill_conditions: If any UC atom is admitted to the canonical graph without explicit kill edges.
If overclaiming atoms are not rewritten per the upgrade list.
If non-canonical vocabulary is not replaced or marked domain-specific.
If the warrant taxonomy is not mapped to canonical grades.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the required kill edges and vocabulary mappings as machine-checkable rules.

plain_summary: This document is an audit of the Unification Atom Set, concluding it is not canon-aligned. It identifies missing kill edges, overclaims, and non-canonical vocabulary, and provides a list of required upgrades. The document itself is a proposal for repair, not a verified claim.
